GenAiFunction.description: Creates an internal follow-up task for the assigned auditor about the rule violations found on an audit case; never emails or contacts anyone externally. If the case's latest replay has no violations, no task is created. It reads the deterministic replay result and raises a task for a human — it never decides compliance, never closes a case, and never contacts a borrower. Idempotent: it will not create a duplicate task if an open alert already exists for the case.
